typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCaly4a_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Trade_ID as string,
		Product_ID as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Product Subtype} as string,
		{Product Description} as string,
		{External Reference} as string,
		TradeStatus as string,
		Book as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		Nominal as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Trade Settle Date} as string,
		{Entered Date} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Updated Date} as string,
		{Sales Person} as string,
		Buy_Sell as string,
		{Modified User} as string,
		{Entered User} as string,
		{Processing Org} as string,
		CptyID as string,
		{Book Id} as string,
		Modified_Date as string,
		Swapwire_ID as string,
		Reason as string,
		Reason_CreatedBy as string,
		Reason_CreateDte as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCaly3a
fromtblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCaly3a derive({Copy of Product_ID} = Product_ID,
		{Copy of Reason_CreatedBy} = Reason_CreatedBy,
		{Copy of Reason_CreateDte} = Reason_CreateDte,
		{Copy of Reason} = Reason,
		{Copy of Swapwire_ID} = Swapwire_ID,
		{Copy of Nominal} = Nominal,
		{Copy of Trade_ID} = Trade_ID,
		{Copy of Modified_Date} = Modified_Date,
		{Copy of Buy_Sell} = Buy_Sell,
		{Copy of CounterParty} = CounterParty,
		{Copy of Trader} = Trader,
		{Copy of TradeStatus} = TradeStatus,
		{Copy of CptyID} = CptyID,
		{Copy of Book} = Book) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Processing_Org as string,
		Entered_User as string,
		Product_ID as string,
		Product_Subtype as string,
		Buy_Sell as string,
		Reason as string,
		External_Reference as string,
		Book as string,
		CptyID as string,
		Modified_User as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Swapwire_ID as string,
		Product_Description as string,
		Book_Id as string,
		Trader as string,
		Trade_ID as string,
		Reason_CreateDte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CounterParty as string,
		Trade_Settle_Date as string,
		Sales_Person as string,
		Updated_Date as string,
		Product_Type as string,
		TradeStatus as string,
		Reason_CreatedBy as string,
		Nominal as string,
		Modified_Date as string,
		Entered_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Processing_Org = {Processing Org},
		Entered_User = {Entered User},
		Product_ID,
		Product_Subtype = {Product Subtype},
		Buy_Sell,
		Reason = {Copy of Reason},
		External_Reference = {External Reference},
		Book,
		CptyID,
		Modified_User = {Modified User},
		Trade_Date = {Trade Date},
		Swapwire_ID,
		Product_Description = {Product Description},
		Book_Id = {Book Id},
		Trader,
		Trade_ID,
		Reason_CreateDte,
		CounterParty,
		Trade_Settle_Date = {Trade Settle Date},
		Sales_Person = {Sales Person},
		Updated_Date = {Updated Date},
		Product_Type = {Product Type},
		TradeStatus,
		Reason_CreatedBy,
		Nominal,
		Modified_Date,
		Entered_Date = {Entered Date}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCaly4a_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCaly4a
